| **《黑色星期五》（Black Friday）** | N/A | N/A | 2020 |
| **《罪惡之城》（City of Crime）** | N/A | N/A | 2020 |
| **《黑暗之眼》（Eye of Darkness）** | N/A | N/A | 2020 |
